text:
Up early and Keen on Driving! 

Billy had to wait a bit longer to pass his test after his initial test was cancelled a few weeks ago due to the snow. 

He was given a more difficult test time of 8am but this didn't phase him. He passed this morning at Nelson Test Centre with only 3 driver faults! 

That's both Billy and his sister taught by me and both with first time passes! 😀

Fantastic drive this morning Billy! Keep driving safe 🚗🚦🎉
